name: Keyword Sufficiency Checker
description: Validate that generated content includes target SEO keywords at the right density and in the right positions (headlines, first paragraphs, meta tags).
usage_notes: Run after content-writer and seo-planner. Checks keyword placement, density, and negative keyword absence. Works without seo-planner data (returns pass with warning). Pure text analysis -- no API calls. B029-4 (v1.1.0, template-v3 unit): keyword extraction now ADDITIVELY unions a shape-agnostic harvester (any `target_keywords`/`keywords`/`head_terms` key at any nesting, plus `keyword_summary_table[].keyword` -- the same collector meta-compliance-checker and seo-planner carry) with the legacy fixed buckets. Legacy shapes score identically; terms only the harvester finds land in the mid-tail bucket (conservative weight). Closes the v3 gap where a section-container plan (category_sections/tag_sections per-section target_keywords, keyword_distribution.tags/credentials/faq keywords) under-counted to zero targets.

options.name: pass_threshold
options.label: Pass threshold
options.description: Minimum keyword_score (0-1) for the entity to get qa_pass: true.

options.name: head_term_density_min
options.label: Min head term density
options.description: Minimum keyword density for head terms (fraction of total words). 0.01 = 1%.

options.name: head_term_density_max
options.label: Max head term density
options.description: Maximum keyword density for head terms (fraction of total words). 0.03 = 3%. Above this signals keyword stuffing.

options.name: check_negatives
options.label: Check negative keywords
options.description: Fail if any negative keywords from the SEO plan appear in the content.

options.name: allow_empty_keyword_plan
options.label: Allow empty keyword plan
options.description: When false (default), the check FAILS loudly if an SEO plan IS present but contains zero keyword targets -- a sign upstream seo-planner produced empty output. Set true to restore the legacy behavior of passing with a warning. (When no SEO plan is present at all, the check always skips with a pass -- this flag does not affect that case.)
